title: Data security startup Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security, which provides non-human identity security, in a deal valued at about $1B (Kyle Alspach/CRN)
summary: Kyle Alspach / CRN: Data security startup Cyera agrees to acquire Oasis Security, which provides non-human identity security, in a deal valued at about $1B — The $1 billion acquisition deal aims to bring capabilities for non-human identity security to the Cyera data security platform.
